function.name: write_report
function.description: Deliver a Markdown report and return an observation. `report` is the full report text; refer to session items by their names: draw charts with ![caption](session://charts/<id>), map files with ![caption](files/<name>.map.json) and table previews with ![caption](session://tables/<name>); link to any item with [text](name). Every reference is checked and unresolved ones are listed for you to patch. Follow the baseline completion rules after delivery.

plan_step.description: When working through a checklist plan: the number (1-based) of the plan step this result serves. Several results can serve one step; a step is checked off once you move on to a later step or finish.

replaces.description: Id of the report to replace, from [REPLACEABLE ARTIFACTS]. Only to fix an artifact the user says is wrong, broken, or unwanted (or one this run made that turned out wrong): the old one is deleted and this takes its place after the latest request. Never when exploring something new; a new artifact keeps the analysis history.

report.description: The full Markdown report text, starting with front matter naming its genre (---\nstyle: notes|analysis|research|search|brief\n---). Embed charts with ![caption](session://charts/<id>): charts in the session or from successful visualize results; embed a map file made with write_map with ![caption](files/<name>.map.json) (a still picture of it). Blocks (see the report skill): :::excerpt{source="<session path>" page=… title="…" url="…"} quotes a source verbatim; :::summary / :::finding / :::caveat / :::definition / :::note callouts; :::metrics (a bullet list of bold numbers); :::compare with :::column{title="…"} blocks; :::details{title="…"} (collapsed); footnote citations [^key] with [^key]: definitions. Close each block with :::.
